name: 诺伊
src: 月银纪史诗/第十二歌_珠湾沉冠.md:228
who: Noi, a human boy of fifteen, an oarsman of the Pearl Bay: about 160 cm, thin, hard-shouldered from rowing, a little broader across the shoulders than other boys his age, still boyish. Short ink-black hair sticking up, pale grey eyes, even brighter than his sister's, that stare without moving as if memorising everything. Cheeks reddened by sea wind, a white scratch across the bridge of the nose from an oyster shell. A thin cord with knots is wound round his left wrist (on the viewer's right when they face us). A watchful, earnest, quiet air.
palette: ink black and pale grey, sea blue, linen white, rope beige
casual: Pearl-diving family clothes: a short linen tunic with the sleeves rolled and short wide trousers, a rope belt with a small knife tucked in it, a thin knotted cord round his left wrist, bare feet. He stands with his hand on the knife hilt and a steady, serious look.
private: A loose undyed long-sleeved linen shirt and plain trousers, a knitted blue scarf, bare feet; arms at his sides, the knotted cord at his wrist. A calm, thoughtful look.
battle: Ready to row hard: the linen tunic belted tight with a rope, leather bracers, trousers tied at the calf; a long oar held upright in both hands beside him like a staff, the small knife at his belt. A set, determined look, mouth closed.
formal: For a ceremony at the harbour: a clean dark-blue wool tunic with long sleeves, laced at the neck with a leather thong and belted with braided sea-rope, tidy trousers and soft shoes, a short oilcloth shoulder cape pinned with a shell clasp that gleams faintly like a pearl, the knotted cord at his wrist. He stands very straight with the hands at his sides, an earnest, solemn look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the pale grey eyes bright and unmoving, looking straight at the viewer, lips closed. Cool sea-grey light from one side, a warm lamp glow behind. Foreground blur: the knotted cord on his wrist, spray and a glowing pearl. He wears the linen tunic.

name: 德米安
src: 月银纪史诗/第十二歌_珠湾沉冠.md:285
who: Damian, a human prince of the Pearl Bay who guards its harbour, twenty-four: about 185 cm, broad-shouldered and well built. Short pale-gold hair swept back by sea wind, eyes the clear green of shallow bay water, a handsome, even face with a white-toothed smile and a short scar on the chin from a sea-shark's tooth. In both ears he wears a plug of wax with a tiny pearl pressed into it. A bright, proud, composed air. The scar on his chin is a short, clearly visible thin pale line on the point of the chin just below the lower lip, drawn in every panel.
face: FACE, as in the references: a handsome even young man's face of about twenty-four, shallow-water green eyes, a thin white scar on the chin, a bright confident smile; skin shadows a soft pink-orange. A short thin pale scar line on the point of the chin, clearly visible.
build: 185 cm, broad-shouldered and sturdy, a swimmer's frame.
palette: pearl white and shallow green, pale gold, sharkskin grey, a soft glow
casual: The pearl armour of the bay's princes: a fitted sharkskin cuirass set with a hundred and twenty small pearls that glow faintly, over a white linen shirt, grey leather trousers and sea boots; a narrow, slightly curved long blade at his left hip (on the viewer's right when they face us); wax plugs with small pearls in both ears. He stands with one hand resting on the sword hilt, a calm, proud smile.
private: A loose white linen shirt with open collar and rolled sleeves, plain dark trousers, soft boots, the wax-and-pearl plugs still in his ears; hands behind his back. A relaxed, tired smile.
battle: Ready on the harbour wall: a fitted sharkskin cuirass and sharkskin arm guards with no steel plates at all, a hundred and twenty small pearls set across the chest and shoulders glowing faintly like light under the sea, a short blue cloak over one shoulder held with a shell clasp, leather gauntlets; the narrow long blade with a thin line of water-light along its edge drawn and held low in his right hand, his left hand open for balance, feet planted. A fierce, steady look, mouth closed.
formal: For a court rite: a long coat of deep sea-blue wool closed with pearl buttons, a high white collar, a silver chain across the chest, a short white cloak with a pearl clasp, the long blade sheathed at his hip. He stands very upright, a calm, regal look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the shallow-green eyes looking at the viewer, a small confident smile. Cool night-blue light from one side while the pearls on his armour glow softly. Foreground blur: drifting glowing pearls and sea spray. He wears the pearl armour.

name: 茉蒂
src: 月银纪史诗/第十二歌_珠湾沉冠.md:341
who: Modi, a halfling woman, the owner of a salt barge of the salt-pan city, thirty-four but with the round youthful look of a halfling: about 118 cm, small, quick and sturdy. Fluffy ginger-yellow curls tied behind her head with a piece of old sailcloth, several strands always escaping. A round face with rosy cheeks, amber eyes that dart around. A talkative, quick-tempered, bargaining air.
palette: ginger yellow and amber, salt-stained cream, sail canvas, rope brown
casual: A salt-stained short coat with the sleeves rolled to the elbow, buttoned up the front, over a plain shirt and long trousers, a rope tied round her middle with a salt knife and a small wax pot hanging from it, bare feet. She stands with her fists on her sides, a lively, argumentative grin.
private: A soft undyed long-sleeved wool shirt and long loose skirt, a knitted shawl, thick socks, the curls loose; a small wax pot at her belt. A tired, content smile.
battle: Ready at the helm: the salt-stained coat buttoned and belted, leather bracers, trousers tied at the ankles; she holds a long tiller-pole upright in both hands, taller than herself, the salt knife at her belt, wax plugs in her ears. A fierce, shouting look.
formal: For a trade meeting: a clean long dark-red wool coat to the knee, straight cut with fitted sleeves, closed with a cast brass toggle and a salt-stained rope belt, a short oilcloth cape pinned at the shoulder, and a small wax pot hanging as a charm at her belt with a faint warm glow in it. She stands very straight, chin up, a shrewd smile.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large and round, the amber eyes darting to one side, a pleased bargaining grin. Bright salty daylight from one side. Foreground blur: a blurred salt-crystal heap, rope and a wax pot. She wears the salt-stained short coat.

name: 珠湾王
src: 月银纪史诗/第十二歌_珠湾沉冠.md:557
who: The old king of the Pearl Bay, sixty years old: about 183 cm, still broad in the chest from youth spent diving deepest of all the bay's princes. A full head of white hair with a faint ring-shaped pressed line round the crown of his head where a crown has sat for forty years. Eyes the clear shallow-water green of his son's. A lined, composed face, a calm, counting air.
face: FACE, as in the references: an aged man's face of about sixty, deep lines at the eyes and mouth, white hair, shallow-water green eyes, a calm composed mouth; skin shadows a soft warm orange-brown.
build: 183 cm, broad-chested, a diver's frame gone heavy with age.
palette: white and shallow green, pearl white, deep sea blue, silver
casual: An old king's plain clothes: a long deep sea-blue wool robe closed with buttons, a silver chain across the chest, a white linen shirt collar, soft boots; no crown on his head. He stands with his hands clasped behind his back, a calm, counting look.
private: A soft grey wool gown over a linen shirt, a knitted shawl, soft shoes, no chain, no crown; hands folded in front. A weary, gentle look.
battle: Commanding from the harbour wall: a sleeveless sharkskin coat set with a few pearls over the blue robe, leather bracers, a plain short cloak; one hand raised palm out, the other at his side, no weapon. A grave, firm look.
formal: The royal robe of the Pearl Bay: a long white and sea-blue layered gown with a wide pearl-embroidered collar, a heavy silver chain, a white mantle, and on his head the crown of the Pearl Bay, a circlet set only with glowing pearls. He stands very upright with an open hand at his side, a solemn look.
art: A head-and-shoulders portrait, the green eyes looking at the viewer calmly, the lips closed. Cool blue light from one side and a warm lantern glow behind. Foreground blur: drifting glowing pearls and mist. He wears the sea-blue robe.
